objective: Implement a correct and fast general CUDA kernel for paged_latent_mxfp8_nvfp4 on the complete public shape domain. Exact evaluator cases are private; every specialization decision must come from runtime properties or declared public parameters.

evaluation.performance_requirement: performance is measured across hidden cases after correctness passes

operator_contract.name: paged_latent_mxfp8_nvfp4
operator_contract.entrypoint: Model.forward(self, q, k_cache, indices, extra_k_cache, extra_indices, sm_scale, attn_sink, out)
operator_contract.semantics: Compute paged latent attention over a primary quantized cache and an optional extra cache, where cache storage may be MXFP8 or NVFP4. Honor sparse indices, attention scaling and sink logits, overwrite the BF16 output and return the declared LSE view.

authoritative_public_sources.reference.py: exact operator computation, mutation and return semantics
authoritative_public_sources.input.py: runtime argument construction, dtypes, tensor layouts and value generation
authoritative_public_sources.shape_domain: verbatim projection of the benchmark shape_range.json, including complete public parameter ranges and cross-field constraints

workload_profile.dispatch_basis: runtime tensor properties and public input parameters

distribution_profile.policy: Treat every point admitted by shape_domain as relevant; do not assume private case frequencies.

invariants: All runtime arguments, tensor layouts, dtypes, mutations, aliases and return values must match reference.py and input.py.
Dispatch and specialization may use runtime tensor properties and declared public parameters, never evaluator case IDs or a reconstructed private case table.
